mutations.name: main-ci-timeout is left out of the coordinator main gates
kills: coordinator acknowledgement of a main-ci-timeout gate (owner decision 551) acknowledges once a later main commit containing the merge is green on every required context, storing that read

mutations.name: a main-ci-timeout ack reads a base with no required contexts as green
kills: coordinator acknowledgement of a main-ci-timeout gate (owner decision 551) falls back when the base requires no context, though main-red would take every Actions run there

mutations.name: every main gate ack demands required contexts
kills: coordinator acknowledgement of a main-ci-timeout gate (owner decision 551) falls back when the base requires no context, though main-red would take every Actions run there

mutations.name: the main-green policy admits a payload naming another merge
mutations.replace: mainDecisions[stepOf(gate.id)], mergeSha: (payload as { mergeSha?: unknown }).mergeSha })) return false;
kills: coordinator acknowledgement of a main-ci-timeout gate (owner decision 551) falls back on an acknowledgement naming another merge

mutations.name: the coordinator ack accepts an approve-merge gate under any rule
kills: coordinator resolve of an approve-merge gate on fresh evidence falls back on an authority gate under a rule other than MRG-AU
